headlines.description: — Yohandy Morales homered for the second time in three games and the Washington Nationals beat the Detroit Tigers 4-2 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yohandry Morales homers, Nationals bullpen hangs on for a 4-2 win over the Tigers

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Pete Alonso hit his 41st home run of the season, Chris Bassitt took a shutout into the sixth inning and the Baltimore Orioles beat the Toronto Blue Jays 4-2 in the first game of a doubleheader Wednesday, eliminating the defending American League...
headlines.shortLinkText: Alonso hits 41st homer as Orioles beat Blue Jays 4-2 to eliminate Toronto from the playoff race

events.name: Minnesota Twins at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter Walker Jenkins hit an RBI single in the seventh inning that put Minnesota ahead and the Twins won their second straight over the San Francisco Giants with a 4-2 victory on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Walker Jenkins' pinch-hit RBI single in the 7th keys Twins' 4-2 victory over Giants

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Trey Gibson pitched brilliantly into the seventh inning and the Baltimore Orioles beat the Toronto Blue Jays 4-2 on Wednesday night to sweep a doubleheader and at least temporarily stay alive in the American League playoff race.
headlines.shortLinkText: Orioles sweep doubleheader against Blue Jays to stave off elimination -- for now

headlines.description: — Christian Yelich and Brice Turang each hit a solo home run and the Milwaukee Brewers slowed Philadelphia’s playoff push with a 4-1 victory over the Phillies on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yelich and Turang homer as Brewers win 99th game and slow Phillies' playoff push

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Matthew Liberatore ended an 11-start winless stretch and Alec Burleson got his major league-best 112th RBI as the St. Louis Cardinals defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Liberatore pitches Cardinals to 5-1 victory that halts Pirates' 5-game winning streak

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Sonny Gray pitched six innings to tie Philadelphia’s Cristopher Sánchez for the major league lead with his 18th victory, Andruw Monasterio drove in the only run with a sixth-inning single, and the Boston Red Sox edged Cleveland 1-0 on Wednesday...
headlines.shortLinkText: Gray earns 18th victory, Monasterio drives in run, and Red Sox edge Guardians 1-0

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Ben Rice hit his 40th and 41st home runs, Ryan McMahon added a grand slam while matching his career high with five RBI and the New York Yankees beat the Tampa Bay Rays 9-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ben Rice hits 40th and 41st homers as Yankees beat Rays 9-2 a day after Tampa Bay clinches AL East

headlines.description: — Chris Sale struck out 10 and reached 200 Ks for the season, Mauricio Dubón delivered a winning RBI single in the 10th inning, and the Atlanta Braves defeated the Cincinnati Reds 3-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chris Sale fans 10, reaches 200 strikeouts for the season as Braves edge Reds 3-2

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Maikel Garcia had three hits and three RBI, including a tiebreaking, run-scoring double in the seventh inning, as the Kansas City Royals beat the White Sox 5-4 Wednesday night and delayed Chicago's bid for a postseason berth.
headlines.shortLinkText: Royals snap a 5-game skid with a 5-4 win over White Sox, delaying Chicago's bid for a playoff berth

headlines.description: — Kyle Stowers homered and the Miami Marlins prevented the Chicago Cubs from clinching a playoff berth for the second straight night with a 3-2 victory Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marlins prevent Cubs from clinching a playoff spot again with a 3-2 victory

events.name: New York Mets at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Marcus Semien hit a tiebreaking homer in the eighth inning against his former team and Brett Baty added a pinch-hit grand slam in the ninth as the New York Mets beat the Texas Rangers 7-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Semien hits tiebreaking HR against old team and Baty adds pinch-hit slam as Mets beat Rangers 7-2

headlines.description: — Corbin Carroll had a two-run triple to cap a four-run first inning and the Arizona Diamondbacks kept their playoff hopes alive with a 5-3 victory over the Colorado Rockies on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Diamondbacks beat the Rockies 5-3 to keep NL wild-card hopes alive

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Donovan Walton hit a three-run homer and rookie Henry Bolte had his first four-hit game to help the Athletics beat the Los Angeles Angels 7-3 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Walton homers and Bolte has 4 hits to lead the Athletics to a 7-3 victory over the Angels

headlines.description: — Josh Naylor singled home Randy Arozarena with the winning run in the 10th inning and the Seattle Mariners kept their slim playoff hopes alive by rallying past the Houston Astros 6-5 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariners rally past Astros 6-5 in 10 innings to keep faint playoff hopes alive

events.name: San Diego Padres at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Manny Machado homered and drove in three runs as the San Diego Padres beat the Los Angeles Dodgers 5-1 on Wednesday night to take sole possession of the top spot in the National League wild-card standings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Machado powers the Padres past the Dodgers 5-1, snapping Los Angeles' 11-game home winning streak
